recipe: Chicken & broccoli stir-fry with egg noodles
servesNote: 2½ portions — Karl 3 : Maria 2. Of 230 g of dry noodles, Karl 138 g, Maria 92 g, and 3/5 of the chicken.
adaptations: ⭐ THIS CARD IS THE REPAIR. It was cooked on 25 Aug from a compressed card that had lost the peppers, and rated 'fine' twice. Karl: 'a lot of steps are now much shorter or missed altogether… e.g. no peppers this time in the stir fry.' The peppers are back — they are structural, not garnish — along with every fix from the library's cooking notes that had never been written into the method: velveting, two batches, dropping the heat before the aromatics, the sauce down the side of the pan, honey and balsamic, toasted almonds, sesame oil off the heat, and less oil.

⚠️ SOY: the library card says '2 tbsp from the new bottle'. There is no bottle — that was corrected in the pantry on 19 Aug, and giving soy in tablespoons when the house holds sachets is a recorded past failure. Use the single 30 ml Gousto sachet; the 8 g ones will not cover it.

ingredients.prep: sliced — ⭐ STRUCTURAL, this is what went missing on the 25th
OFF the heat, at the very end
deliberately less than last time — it was too oily on the 19th
the Gousto 30 ml sachet — NOT the 8 g ones, and there is no bottle
1 tsp to velvet the chicken, 1 tsp slaked for the sauce
at the table, not in the pan

equipment.why: wide enough to hold the chicken in a single layer
the sauce, mixed before anything hits the heat

prep: ⭐ VELVET THE CHICKEN FIRST — it needs 20 minutes and everything else fits inside that. Slice thin, toss with 1 tbsp cold water until it is fully absorbed, then 1 tsp cornflour, then a teaspoon of oil. Leave 20 min. This is the fix from the 25th and it is still untested, so judge it.
Broccoli into florets, stalks sliced thin so they cook in the same time.
Mix the sauce in a bowl: the 30 ml soy sachet, rice wine, mirin, honey, balsamic, and 1 tsp cornflour slaked in a splash of COLD water. Mixing it now is why step 5 takes seconds.
Toast the flaked almonds in a dry pan until they smell nutty and are just golden. Straight out of the pan or they carry on cooking.

steps.text: ⭐ Noodles on to boil NOW — run them CONCURRENTLY with the chicken, not after it. This is the fix from 19 Aug: the linear step list was what cost the time, and Karl finished in 15 min against a 28 min estimate by parallelising anyway.
Hot pan, the olive oil, chicken in a single layer and in TWO batches. Leave it until it releases cleanly from the pan and the underside is golden. Crowding steams it. Out to a plate between batches.

Broccoli and peppers in, splash of water, lid on until the broccoli goes bright green and still has bite and the peppers have softened but keep a little snap. The peppers are not a garnish — they were dropped on the 25th and the dish was worse for it.
⭐ DROP THE HEAT before the aromatics go in. Ginger & garlic paste, about 30 seconds, until it smells sweet rather than raw. On full heat it scorches and turns bitter.

Chicken back in. ⭐ Pour the sauce down the SIDE of the pan, not into the middle — it hits hot metal and thickens as it runs in rather than cooling everything and stewing. Toss until it coats and gloss appears.
Drained noodles through the pan and toss. Sesame oil OFF THE HEAT — its flavour is volatile and cooking it just makes the dish oily. Almonds scattered over. Sriracha at the table.
